growth.description: Perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1 and below `rate`.

growth_cap.description:
Upper bound for the perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none,
reported as absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused.

nopat_next.description:
Net operating profit after tax of the first period after the horizon, NOPAT_{N+1}, in
currency units.

rate.description: Discount rate of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period; must exceed `growth`.

ronic.description: Return on new invested capital (RONIC), decimal fraction per period, greater than 0.
